claim_text: Total caffeine exposure should include all dietary and supplemental sources; habitual intake, individual sensitivity, sleep, health conditions and medicines influence the safety of additional caffeine.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, context-specific assessment and prevent inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults reporting high habitual caffeine intake and considering additional caffeine for performance.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental sources; verify product label and total exposure.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes caffeine use and safety considerations.
limitations: A single threshold is not universally safe; total exposure and individual context matter.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
